newsitem.title: UK: Annington Homes prices 3 bonds for 903.80 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Annington Homes prices 3 bonds for 903.80 mln stg.

text.p: Annington Homes -- the consortium that bought British Ministry of Defence living quarters -- has priced its three bonds worth 903.80 million stg launched earlier.
HSBC Markets and Nomura International are joint lead managers on the transaction which will securitise rental income from the properties.
The MoD sold 57,400 homes for 1.662 billion stg to Annington last month in a deal underwritten by Nomura International.
The Annington Homes consortium is made up of Abbey National Treasury Services, AMEC Group, Hambros Bank, Midland Bank, Nomura and the Royal Bank of Scotland.
